header.text: Tech Lead · Backend Engineer · AI Product Systems
I’m Daejeong Kim, a maker who turns possibilities into opportunities and delivers value through products.

blocks.text: Working language: Korean
Tech Lead · Backend Engineer | Full-time, early member
Proposed Thready and led product design, development, launch, and operation, working with planning, QA, and marketing teammates to build a paid AI content service for creators expanding to Threads.
Built the backend, AI generation and evaluation systems, and core user and admin workflows. Used human-rated examples to guide generation and recorded LLM evaluation history for review.

Moved generation to background processing after observing users prepare content in advance. Built an agent prototype exposing existing APIs through MCP and began customer A/B testing of conversational workflows.

Separated AI execution into its own service and database, retaining product records in the main backend. Used a transactional outbox, retries, and version checks to protect newer state from duplicate or out-of-order delivery.

Implemented scheduled drafts, approval notifications, and transactional approval commands. Designed recovery to distinguish pre-call failures from unknown external outcomes and resume the existing publishing attempt.

Led planning, design, and development of a medical knowledge base used in internal consultations. Connected terminology curated by clinic operations teams to help correct medical terms in speech-to-text and translation.

Led inventory and ordering backends, Redis-based SSO session redesign, and multi-clinic reservation APIs and policies. Co-led the real-time AI consultation backend and implemented operational integrations.
Owned operations of the company’s Azure infrastructure, managed with Terraform. Consolidated service instances, contributing to an approximately 30–40% reduction in monthly server costs.

Built a standard FastAPI template to help planning, QA, and design teammates implement features with coding agents. Led product planning, issue tracking, and releases, and helped design AI-assisted company workflows.
Backend Engineer | Freelance, pre-incorporation engagement

Built the initial dermatology CRM backend and established repository structure, development environments, documentation, and issue and pull-request conventions before MediSolve AI’s incorporation. Joined MediSolve AI full-time in April 2025.
Backend Engineer | Intern, then full-time; company later closed
Led the manual-capture prepayment integration and added cancellation/refund handling for failed reservations. Moved loyalty-point restoration and pass removal to refund completion.
Added immediate and scheduled message/email delivery to an existing multilingual follow-up survey flow, with cancellation, rescheduling, and delivery history.
Vision AI Engineer / Product Manager / Backend Engineer | Full-time
**Vision AI Engineer (Dec 2021 - Sep 2022):** Contributed to apparel-image analysis model development for SellerCanvas.
**Product Manager (Oct 2022 - Sep 2023):** Led SellerCanvas from prototype to v1.0, defining product workflows, feature scope, and release priorities.
Translated business requirements into technical specifications for enterprise fashion-brand PoCs, coordinating scope, schedules, and technical validation.

Redesigned the product-page creation workflow, defined product-data criteria with fashion specialists, and designed the page-layout algorithm, contributing as a co-inventor of METHOD FOR DISPLAYING PAGE.
**Backend Engineer (Oct 2023 - Jan 2024):** Transitioned into backend development.
Vision AI Engineer | Intern
Helped establish the student startup Izsol and developed Kidsly, a facial-recognition attendance system. Acquired training data through a national program and trained YOLO models.
Backend & Infrastructure Lead | Team side project
Led Spring Boot backend development and AWS deployment and monitoring. Used Java, Spring, and Spring Boot across three side projects.
**Backend:** Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0 async, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, TypeScript, NestJS, RabbitMQ, TaskIQ
**AI / LLM:** LangGraph, RAG, MCP, LLM integration and evaluation, speech-to-text
**Frontend:** Next.js, TypeScript (core user and admin workflows)
**Engineering Tools:** Claude Code, Codex, pytest, Ruff, Pyright, Docker, GitHub Actions, Sentry, Jira
**Additional:** Java, Spring, Spring Boot (side projects); Azure, Terraform (infrastructure operations); AWS, Vercel (deployment and environment setup)
